name: Wire Tapper
ability: On Night 1, if you use your ability, the Demon learns one in-play role as part of their bluffs, and 1 Townsfolk is drunk until dusk. The Demon learns you are in play.
firstNightReminder: The Wire Tapper may use their ability. If they say yes, replace a Demon bluff with an in-play role (not the Wire Tapper). Mark one Townsfolk as Wires Crossed.

jinxes.reason: If the Snitch is in play, one Minion bluff is also affected by the Wire Tapper: no additional Townsfolk are made drunk.

name: Firebug
ability: On Night 1, choose a good player to hold the bomb. Each night*, that player chooses a living player to hold the bomb. If the Demon chooses a player with the bomb, they choose again. You learn evil players holding the bomb.
flavor: They told me I have an explosive personality, and I chose to take that literally.
otherNightReminder: Wake the player holding the Firebug's bomb and inform them they are holding it, and they choose a player. If an evil player is selected, wake the Firebug to inform them.

jinxes.reason: If the Alchemist gains the Firebug's ability and the Demon chooses a player holding the bomb, the Demon does not choose who dies next. The Alchemist does not learn if evil players hold the bomb.
If the Goon is chosen to hold the bomb, that player can change the Goon's alignment and become drunk. The Goon holds the bomb regardless of whether this happens.
The Pukka does not get to choose again if they choose a player holding the bomb on Night 1.

name: Polterghast
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Once per game, at night*, you may choose to register as dead & poison 1 Townsfolk neighbour.
flavor: 'Over my dead body', you say? Well, if you insist.
otherNightReminder: The Polterghast chooses a player :reminder:. They may also choose to use their ability to feign death. Give them the 'Play Dead' token and announce them as dead in the morning.

jinxes.reason: If the Polterghast dies while registering as dead, the Scarlet Woman becomes the Polterghast whose ability has already been used.

name: Mad Scientist
ability: Each night*, choose a dead player. They are poisoned and alive until dusk.
otherNightReminder: The Mad Scientist chooses a dead player. :reminder:

name: Taxidermist
ability: Dead votes can be used to nominate. If you die, travel out or are exiled, choose 1-3 players: they regain their vote token.
flavor: The difference between the tax man and the taxidermist is that the taxidermist leaves the skin.

name: Peanut Gallery
ability: Before characters are drawn, spectators choose one player. They win and lose with that player.
